decisions.hidden_reasoning:
I need to pick three from my roster against their threats like Hatterene, Gholdengo, and Kingambit. I'm weighing Incineroar for intimidate and fake out utility, Garchomp as a strong mega option, plus my own Kingambit, Gholdengo, and Sinistcha as possible picks.

Thinking through type matchups: Garchomp's Earthquake hits Kingambit and Gholdengo super effectively since they're Steel types, while Rotom-Wash is immune to Ground via Levitate. Against Hatterene's Psychic/Fairy typing, I need to remember Fairy is actually immune to Dragon-type attacks, so Garchomp's Dragon moves won't work there.

Considering team composition, Corviknight's Flying/Steel typing resists both Psychic and Fairy, making it a solid answer to Hatterene specifically. I'll settle on Incineroar, Garchomp, and Corviknight for this matchup.

decisions.hidden_reasoning:
I'm checking Fake Out against Gholdengo — since it's part Ghost, Normal moves have no effect, so that's a wasted turn. Flare Blitz is super effective on its Steel typing though, but Gholdengo outspeeds Incineroar, so I need to weigh the damage trade carefully.

I'm weighing Parting Shot to drop Gholdengo's offenses and bring in Garchomp for an Earthquake, but Garchomp isn't Mega yet and Steel doesn't get resisted by its typing anyway. Given Incineroar's solid bulk, going straight for Flare Blitz for the big hit seems like the better line.

decisions.hidden_reasoning:
Rotom-Wash's Levitate makes it immune to Earthquake, and Garchomp's Stone Edge and Dragon Claw are both neutral against it. Since Garchomp outspeeds at 158 Speed, Swords Dance could set up safely here.

Right, Electric is neutral against Steel, so Corviknight would take double damage as a pure Flying-type weakness. For Garchomp, Stone Edge is the reliable neutral option against Rotom-Wash since Dragon moves get resisted, though Swords Dance to set up is also tempting given Garchomp's speed advantage.

decisions.thought: Garchomp (8 HP) outspeeds Rotom-Wash, which is at 47% and has Levitate, so Earthquake will not hit it. Stone Edge should KO on a hit (the previous one did about 53%). decisions.hidden_reasoning:
Garchomp is down to 8 HP while Rotom-Wash sits around 47%. Since Rotom-Wash has Levitate, Earthquake won't work despite what the action list suggests; Stone Edge would just be neutral damage given Rotom's typing.

Comparing Stone Edge versus Dragon Claw, the math suggests Stone Edge's higher power gives a real shot at a kill if it connects despite its lower accuracy, while Dragon Claw is reliable but likely falls just short of finishing Rotom off. Since Garchomp outspeeds, Stone Edge first seems like the play, though I'm also weighing whether switching to Corviknight might be safer given Rotom's Hydro Pump threat and Corviknight's resistances.
